ValidationRule.description: When rate and revenue are populated, Actual Amount must equal rate x revenue, rounded up to the next cent. Applied Royalty Rate is a Percent field (5% = 0.05 in formulas), so no /100 is needed. Blank rate/revenue (flat-fee) rows are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Applied_Royalty_Rate__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Reported_Royalty_Revenue__c)), IP_Actual_Amount__c <> CEILING( Applied_Royalty_Rate__c * Reported_Royalty_Revenue__c * 100 ) / 100 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Actual Amount must equal Applied Royalty Rate x Reported Royalty Revenue, rounded up to the next whole cent.
